body:
Vendored GOLDENBAND general-skeleton renderer + mannequin mesh/animation library from SHANKPIT into day/, wired a real test-NPC draw path into the client (mannequin + zombie-clip kits share one skeleton, confirmed live via matching joint/channel names). Found+fixed a real GSEQ_MAX_CHANNELS(256) bug live-blocking 4 of 5 SHANKPIT NPC kits (fixed upstream d14c7a6 + here). Built core/humanness.c (MISHRI primitives, vendored from SHANKPIT, 7 tests re-verified), core/npc_archetype.c (Citizens/The Men, dynamic vigilance feeding witness_rules.c's real attention mechanism, 7 statistical tests), core/zombie_values.c (zombies' own hunger/aggression/decay vocabulary, distinct from human moods per founder direction, 11 statistical tests, one real bug found+fixed writing the tests). NORTHSTAR.md S8 scoping pass names 5 deferred phases. Commits daf638a/eddaecb/5de1a29.

⚓ ☃
